CAPSIM001.name: Canonical capital policy snapshot
CAPSIM001.rule: Bind existing OB_EFFECTIVE_POLICY_V1 capital limits without replacing or widening Effective Policy.

CAPSIM002.name: Simulation capital state snapshot
CAPSIM002.rule: Bind lane-local starting capital, cash, PnL, equity, peak equity, and drawdown into a tamper-evident snapshot.

CAPSIM003.name: Proposed capital-use assessment
CAPSIM003.rule: Known cash, position-allocation, and per-trade-loss violations block. Missing daily/session loss truth does not silently pass.

CAPSIM004.name: Fail-closed capital defense receipt
CAPSIM004.rule: Assessment identity is account-bound, lane-bound, policy-bound, state-bound, proposal-bound, and tamper-evident.

CAPSIM005.name: Strict simulation authority boundary
CAPSIM005.rule: CAPSIM cannot move real capital, submit broker orders, select contracts, widen policy, mutate lanes, or unlock modes.
